verdict: Local interest is rising, but paid ads are off and site traffic is falling.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, paid advertising on both Meta and Google ran no spend, so your Google Business Profile carried all engagement — 27 actions including 2 calls, 14 direction requests, and 11 website clicks. That local activity is a bright spot: GBP actions jumped 50% compared to the prior week, signaling real demand in your area. At the same time, website traffic and organic search clicks each dropped roughly 41% week-over-week, meaning fewer people are reaching your site once they look beyond your profile. Paid campaigns are being reviewed for reactivation to capture the local intent that organic alone cannot convert into leads. Next period, expect paid channels to return to activity and site traffic to stabilize as that work moves forward.

watch_item.issue: Paid advertising has been inactive across all channels for the full 28-day window, leaving local demand without a direct path to leads.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaigns are under review for reactivation this week so that the local interest already showing in your profile has somewhere to convert.
